_source: Fixed values (namespace, title, seed, model, size, pt, touch, spacing): the same TLP1035T profile as Afterburn's, since Mach 1035 is the same panel at the same 149 DPI; touch-target minimums are keyed to physical PPI, not to theme (docs/design-rules.md section 1-2).

Popup size: the most common popup size in seeds/Mach 1035.gdl that is not 1280x800 - 995x549, on 10 of its 26 popups (the other 16 are full 1280x800). Identical in seeds/Mach ECP 16-10.gdl; seeds/Mach 1535.gdl is a different, 1920x1080 panel and was not used for this.

Colors: seeds/Mach 1035.gdl's own button per-state fill, stroke and text color, and its PBShape fills (python theme_survey.py, and Project.fill_map()/pages() from gdl/project.py), cross-checked against `python -m gdl.themes` on 'Mach 1020 Series.glt' and against Mach Styles.psd's 'Colors' layer group and its selected/unselected same-hue alpha-only rule (docs/design-rules.md section 7; research/psd_layer_names.py run on 'C:\Users\Public\Documents\Extron\GUI Designer Templates\Resources\Mach\Style Sheet\Mach Styles.psd'). `page` is approximated, not measured: Mach's own pages usually show a full-bleed photo (its 'Main BG Image'/'mach-bg-02' PSD layers) that no flat token can represent, so `page` stands in with the template's own dominant SOLID (fully opaque) fill instead - #303030, the seed's 13 'Modal Window' shapes (0,64 1280x681 on Help, Display, Screen, Lighting and Audio Settings, Camera Select, Window Layout, Recording Controls, the three confirmations, Starting Up and Powering Down), matching 13 of gdl.themes' extract on the raw .glt exactly; the header and footer bars are #000000B4, and the 995x549 standard popups have no fill - the same method gdl/designsys/shockwave.json's own `page` uses. `scrim` is not measured per-theme at all: Build draws every modal popup as the page beneath under black at alpha 166 (0xA6) regardless of its authored background - the same value gdl/designsys/afterburn.json reports measuring identically on the Afterburn, Mach and Shockwave seeds - so it is fixed here to match, not derived from Mach's own palette, and gdl/spec.py's Panel.palette() excludes a modal's background from the six-color count for the same reason.

Type: seeds/Mach 1035.gdl's own label and button point sizes in the 'Open Sans' face. The seed also defines 'Open Sans Light', at 12 to 35 pt, which this system does not offer; a spec can ask for it (Project.font_resource_names() lists it; docs/design-rules.md section 7). Counts corroborated exactly by seeds/Mach ECP 16-10.gdl and, in shape, by seeds/Mach 1535.gdl. Every measured Font.Style.Bold is false, so every style here is weight 400, unlike Afterburn's - Mach's real hierarchy leans on the Light face, not on bold, matching Shockwave's own finding.

Borders: gdl.spec.BORDERS keys whose resource seeds/Mach 1035.gdl defines (Project.border_resource_names()) - `mach`, its own, plus the four generic 2D primitives also defined there. Radius/thickness from gdl.spec.BORDER_GEOMETRY, except `ellipse`: BORDER_GEOMETRY's own entry for '2D Ellipse' is (0, 3), which is the resource's raw dataField and not a corner radius - GUI Designer draws this shape as an ellipse by object type - so radius is set to -1 (a circle) here, the same convention gdl/designsys/afterburn.json's own ellipse uses. Counted over every page and popup of the seed, Project.border_resources() shows only `mach` and `rounded` (2D Rounded Rectangle) actually drawn with in the seed; `rect`, `capsule` and `ellipse` are defined but otherwise-undrawn-with generic escape hatches, as in the Afterburn profile.

Buttons: seeds/Mach 1035.gdl's own per-state fills, borders and images, read with gdl.project.Project on every PBButton state. ghost and solid author '2D Rounded Rectangle' (`rounded`) on most buttons and no border on a minority (Main SD's header tabs and footer cells - Room Mode, Window Layout, Recording Controls, Help, Power - Main Multi-Window's Window 1 and 2, Main VC's Share Content and the recording layout buttons); the `mach` resource the seed defines is on 16 of its 662 button states. Icons are small, mostly transparent kit images laid over the button's fill (1376x440_pc.png with a caption indented four spaces; 440x440_camera.png with the caption below; 700x448_power.png alone) - `with_icon`. A few are whole-button images, which no Mach variant offers: Window Layout's twelve presets (preset-01_nsel.png and on, with no fill), TV Channels' logos (755x440_abc.png) and the recording layouts (712x440_generic_*.png). The seed's red actions - Confirmation's Power Down, Confirmation - Recording's Record, Incoming Call's Decline, Main VC's End Call, Screen Settings' Stop - are #A829258C or #A82925DC, then solid alert when pressed, on '2D Rounded Rectangle' - `alert`; its green ones (Main VC's Make Call, Incoming Call's Accept) #659945DC or #65994596, then #86D161 - `call`. 56 buttons draw an Extron-Lift glyph as their caption (arrows, transport, back, delete, keyboard, more); a design system draws no glyph - Extron's icon fonts carry no license field - so the kit's own images of the same icons stand in.

Schemes: one, `default`. Mach's named swatches (green, blue, red, yellow, white, gray - Mach Styles.psd's 'Colors' group) act as fixed status colors used together on a single seed panel - e.g. seeds/Mach 1035.gdl uses yellow for selection and red and green elsewhere, all in the one project - not as alternate branding schemes a project picks one of, unlike Afterburn's four.

Slider: measured on Main Volume Slider (30x290): an 8 px track, a 30x30 thumb, all three drawn from images the seed carries and the kit folder does not - 8x500_mach_track_bg@3x.png, 8x500_mach_track_fill@3x.png, 40_mach_thumb@3x.png - extracted to vendor/ with `python -m gdl.designsys extract mach`. A clone keeps its donor's, which is these, so the panel is right either way; the canvas draws them. Level: assumed, as before - the seed has none; its Up and Down, where a level stands in for a slider, show the kit's volume-up and volume-down where their look draws an icon (`steps`), as the 525's own Volume Up and Down are glyphs.

Themes: every one of Mach 1035's 8 pages draws mach-bg-02.png, the pastel mountain sunset, full-bleed (Project.pages()); the kit ships it and five others at 5472x3648 (Resources/Mach/Backgrounds). All six are offered, the seed's first. Extron publishes no pairing for Mach, and it has one accent scheme.

Layout: each series' working page, measured into its `panels` entry's `frame` off its seed by tests/measure_series.py frame_of - Main SD on the bar series, the hubs' Main Page, the 320's Doc Cam 1 - from which the README's Layout is written. `main` is the 1035's band between the header and footer bars (64-745) and between the rails (140-1140). The seed's DefaultPage is Start, a splash page with no bars (`layout.start`). Labels on the photo - Main SD's rail headings - are black (#000000, the seed's own); labels on a bar are white.
title: Extron Mach
tagline: Extron's Mach touch-panel template, for TLP Pro panels.

schemes.name: Mach
schemes.usage: Mach's only scheme. Its swatches are fixed status colors, not alternate branding to pick between.

colors.name: page
colors.usage: The opaque window between the bars: #303030, the 'Modal Window' (0,64 1280x681) of the template's Help, settings windows, confirmations, Starting Up and Powering Down, and the ground of a hub's settings popups; and a page's ground where no photo is drawn. The header and footer bars are `shade`, and a standard popup has no fill. One of the panel's six.

colors.name: raised
colors.usage: A ghost key's fill at rest: a white wash at alpha 50 (0x32), only ever on a dark ground - a source popup's shade well, a #303030 window, the hubs' menu bar - never on the photo. The seed's single most common button look (189 of Mach 1035's 327 authored button-state pairs); matches Mach Styles.psd's White swatch unselected alpha exactly. One of the panel's six.

colors.name: pressed
colors.usage: Button fill when On or pressed: the same white wash at alpha 120 (0x78) - Mach's own rule of moving alpha rather than hue. Pairs with raised on the same 189 button-state pairs; matches the PSD's White swatch selected alpha exactly. One of the panel's six.

colors.name: text
colors.usage: Captions, labels, headings. The seed's own button and label text color. One of the panel's six.

colors.name: ink
colors.usage: Text that sits on the photo rather than on a bar or button: a rail's heading, a source's caption, a status line. Black - the seed's own labels on the photo are #000000 (Display, Volume, Settings, PC, Laptop). Text on a bar or button is `text`.

colors.name: accent
colors.usage: An active mute or privacy: Display Mute, Volume Mute, the mic, program and main mutes, Display 1 and 2 Mute and Privacy - solid yellow with a black (`ink`) caption, on 18 of the seed's button states. The PSD's yellow swatch (237, 185, 94, its Colors group). A chosen tab, source or list row does not turn yellow: it moves to `shade-on` or `pressed`. One of the panel's six.

colors.name: alert
colors.usage: The red of an action that stops or ends something - Power Down on the confirmation, Decline, End Call, Screen 1-4 Stop - or starts what attendees must be told of: Record, on its confirmation. Solid while it is pressed. The PSD's red swatch (226, 54, 54). The template has no fault indicator and paints no mute red. One of the panel's six.

colors.name: alert-dim
colors.usage: The red action at rest: #A829258C on Power Down, Record, Decline and Stop, #A82925DC on End Call, each solid `alert` when pressed. Share Content's On, its live state, is the #A82925DC on no border and is never solid. Not one of the panel's core six unless swapped in.

colors.name: text-muted
colors.usage: The date and time in the footer: #808080, as Main SD's SD Date/Time draws it (in Open Sans Light 16, which this system draws in Open Sans). Not one of the panel's core six.

colors.name: call-dim
colors.usage: Starting a call, at rest: Make Call's green at alpha 220 (0xDC; Accept's rests at 0x96), becoming solid `call-on` when pressed - the `call` variant. Not one of the panel's core six.

colors.name: call-on
colors.usage: Starting a call, pressed: Make Call's, Accept's and VC Call's solid green. Not one of the panel's core six.

colors.name: steel
colors.usage: A secondary choice at rest: Contacts' steel blue at alpha 80 (0x50), `steel-on` when On. Not one of the panel's core six.

colors.name: steel-on
colors.usage: A secondary choice when On: Camera Near and Far's steel blue at alpha 140 (0x8C). Not one of the panel's core six.

colors.name: accent-dim
colors.usage: Privacy at rest: a dim yellow at alpha 220 (0xDC), solid `accent` when on; Flash rests at the accent itself at alpha 80 (#EDB95E50). Not one of the panel's core six.

colors.name: text-secondary
colors.usage: A de-emphasised label: the Recording Controls window's ALL CAPS status labels (TITLE:, USB STATUS:), opened from Main Recording, five of the seed's own labels. Not one of the panel's core six unless swapped in for text.

colors.name: shade
colors.usage: A darker button, panel or bar fill: black at alpha 180 (0xB4). The seed's second most common button look, and the template's own dominant authored fill. Not one of the panel's core six unless swapped in for raised.

colors.name: shade-on
colors.usage: The On or pressed counterpart to shade: Mach Styles.psd's 'gray dark' swatch (31, 41, 46) at alpha 160 (0xA0). Pairs with shade on the same 80 button-state pairs. Not one of the panel's core six unless swapped in for pressed.

colors.name: scrim
colors.usage: Behind a full-screen modal popup. Build draws every modal as the page beneath under black at alpha 166 (0xA6) regardless of the page's own background - the same value measured on the Afterburn, Mach and Shockwave seeds alike (gdl/designsys/afterburn.json). Not one of the panel's six - Build adds it, the design doesn't choose it.

type.name: title
type.usage: The room's name on the Start page: Room Title, Open Sans 32, black on the photo. The largest heading on a working page is Room Mode VC's prompt, Please select a room mode, in Open Sans Light 28, a face this system does not offer.

type.name: header
type.usage: The header's title on the one Main page whose header has one: Main Select Source's Select a source, Open Sans Light 26 in white, centred on its bar. The working pages' headers hold the source tabs instead (Layout); this system draws Open Sans, not Light.

type.name: heading
type.usage: A popup's or a window's title: Open Sans Light 24, white, at its top left - Help, Document Camera, Display Settings, Camera Select, Lighting Settings and the template's other titles. This system offers Open Sans, so 24 pt Open Sans.

type.name: body
type.usage: Labels, status and paragraphs. The seed's most common label size (39 of Mach 1035's own labels, identical in Mach ECP 16-10); also its date/time control's own size in Open Sans.

type.name: button-large
type.usage: A dial pad's digits: VTC Dialer's keys and its period, Open Sans 20 (15 of 203 sized button captions). The template's main actions - Press to begin, Presentation, Video Conference, the tabs - are 16 pt: `body`.

type.name: button
type.usage: The caption of a small button. Mach's own buttons are most often 12 pt (113 of 203, identical in Mach ECP 16-10), under the 14 pt minimum the toolkit checks, so 14 is the floor here - Afterburn's own small-button type does the same lift from 13.

mach.usage: Mach's own rounded corner, 10 px with a 2 px stroke: slider and level tracks, and 16 of the seed's 662 button states. Most of its buttons are on `rounded`, which the seed draws square; give a button this border for a rounded corner or an outline.

rounded.usage: A generic rounded rectangle. One of only two border resources the seed actually draws with, on 3 shapes. In seeds/Mach 1035.gdl it draws no stroke and its corners come out square (radius 1).

rect.usage: A square-cornered fill on '2D Rectangle', which only the hubs' Right Menu Background draws (the 525's and 535's); the 1035's bars and wells have no border resource (`none`).

ellipse.usage: A circle or ellipse, drawn round at any size.

none.usage: No border resource: the fill alone, square-cornered - the seed's header tabs and footer cells, and its bars and wells.

ghost.usage: A key on a dark ground - a source popup's well, a #303030 window, the hubs' menu bar: a white wash, brighter when On (189 of Mach 1035's 327 authored button-state pairs). The template draws none on the photo. With an `icon` and a caption, the kit's 440x440 icon with the caption under it, as Camera Select's Camera 1 and 2; with no caption, the icon alone, centered.

solid.usage: The page's button, and the default: the rails' Display and Settings keys, Mute, the source tabs and the footer's cells are shade at rest and `shade-on` when On (80 of 327 pairs). With an `icon` and a caption, the kit's 1376x440 icon strip at its left and the caption after it, as the header's source tabs; with no caption, the icon alone, centered.

highlight.usage: An active mute or privacy: shade at rest, solid `accent` with a black caption when On - Display Mute, Volume Mute, the mic and program mutes, Privacy. A selection is not a highlight: a tab, a source or a list row moves to `shade-on` or `pressed`.

source.usage: A source tile, as Main Select Source draws its four: a shade square 100x100 with the kit's 440x440 icon (laptop_2, pc_2) and no caption, the source's name in a Label under it (Open Sans Light 16, black). On the working pages a source is a Header tab instead (`slot="source"`).

footer.usage: A footer cell: square-cornered shade, no border - Room Mode, Help and Power. Help is its word (Open Sans 12 in the template), Power the kit's 700x448 power icon alone. With an `icon` and a caption, the icon at its left and the caption after it.

alert.usage: An action that stops or ends something: Power Down on the confirmation, Decline, End Call, Screen Stop; or one that starts what attendees must be told of, Record. A dim red at rest, solid `alert` when pressed, on '2D Rounded Rectangle' (square on Mach).

call.usage: Starting a call: Make Call and Accept. A dim green at rest, solid green when pressed, on '2D Rounded Rectangle' (square on Mach).

line.note: Mach draws no line on any page or popup: it divides with 1 px gaps that let the photo through - between the header's tabs, the footer's cells, a rail group's keys and a source well's title and body - which the region components keep.

cover.pattern: rounded tiles cut at the Mach 10 px radius

iconography.icon_prop: Mach mostly shows state with the button's fill: the kit draws each icon in white. The few template buttons that swap their icon by state (Privacy, Record, VC Call, the Window Layout presets) give that state its own `icon`.
iconography.intro: Mach shows state mostly with a button's fill: the kit draws each icon in white, and a button lights by moving to a brighter fill (`raised` to `pressed`, `shade` to `shade-on`), or, for an active mute or privacy, to solid `accent`. A few swap the icon as well - Privacy's privacy_nsel to privacy_sel, Record's record_1 to record_red_1 - which a state's own `icon` does. Every icon comes from Mach's own resource kit through a Button's `icon` - never draw one. The template draws arrows, transport, back, delete, keyboard and more as Extron-Lift glyph captions, which this system does not draw (Extron's icon fonts carry no license field): the kit's images of the same icons stand in.
rules: **Which button**: page buttons - the rails, the tabs - are `solid` (the default), and the footer's Room Mode, Help and Power `footer`; a key in a source's well or in a window is `ghost`. With an `icon` and a caption, `solid` sets the icon at the left and the caption after it, as the tabs, and `ghost` the icon above its caption, as Camera Select's; with no caption, the icon alone, centered. A source tile (`source`, as Main Select Source's) has its icon and no caption, its name a Label under it.
**Feedback**: every state must look different - a brighter fill, or `accent` with an `ink` caption for an active mute or privacy (`highlight`).

**Red and green** mark actions, not faults: `alert` for one that stops or ends something - Power Down, End Call, Decline - or starts what attendees must be told of, Record; and `call` for starting a call (Make Call, Accept).

start.attrs: name="Room Title" type="title" align="center" does="The room's name, which the program sets."

examples.states_note: In Mach an On state moves the same fill to a brighter alpha (raised/pressed, shade/shade-on); an active mute or privacy fills solid `accent` instead, with a black (`ink`) caption, as Muted here - see the highlight variant.
examples.group_note: The cap is Mach's own source row - four across, on Main Select Source's tiles (100x100, 60 px apart) and the header's tabs (190x64, 1 px apart) - but the gap is not: set `gap` and `cell` for the group you mean.
examples.color_rule: A theme's photo behind everything; `shade` for the header and footer bars, the rails' keys and the well of a source's popup, and `page` for a window between the bars; `raised`/`pressed` for the ghost keys on those dark grounds; `text` on a bar, a well or a button, `ink` on the photo; `accent` only for an active mute or privacy, with an `ink` caption; `alert` for an action that stops or ends something (Power Down, End Call) or starts a recording (Record), and `call-dim`/`call-on` for starting a call.

themes.name: Sunset
themes.usage: Pastel mountains at sunset - the seed's own, behind every one of its pages.

themes.name: Dome
themes.usage: A grey tiled dome against a slate sky. From Mach's kit.

themes.name: Lake
themes.usage: Blue hills over still water. From Mach's kit.

themes.name: Forest
themes.usage: A misty violet forest. From Mach's kit.

themes.name: Ridges
themes.usage: Layered blue mountain ridges. From Mach's kit.

themes.name: Facade
themes.usage: A curved glass facade against a white sky. From Mach's kit.

layout.bars_note: Its bars and rails are controls over the photograph, not background art, so on a panel other than the one drawn a Page's own children go through both panels' bands (docs/claude-design.md section 4).
layout.main_note: Between the header and footer bars (64-745 down) and between the rails (140-1140 across): the photo, where the page's main task sits.
regions: **The right rail's slider** is 30 wide in the Layout and is drawn 53 on the 1035, since 30 is under the 53 px touch minimum the toolkit checks: the RightRail grows it about its centre, and on another panel to that panel's own minimum.
layout.start: Mach's panel boots to Start, its seed's DefaultPage: a splash page with no bars - the room's name on the photo (Room Title), Press to begin, lighting presets and the volume - from which its working pages are reached.

regions._source: What the region components draw by default (docs/claude-design.md section 3): the clock's pattern off the seed's own Main SD (the 1035's SD Date/Time draws September 28, 1960 - 12:00 AM), and the looks the hand-laid slice of that page (tests/data/design-slice-mach) built and verified with - solid rail buttons and tabs, a solid Mute, On in accent; a footer Room Mode, Help and Power, Power its kit icon; a heading centred in body type; a tab's caption centred past its icon. The seed's Main SD draws every rail button, Mute and Room Mode in its shade (0,0,0,180 on 6176 of 6180 pixels). `rail` is a LeftRail's first group's, `launcher` (else `rail`) its later groups', `mode` the Footer's mode slot's.

mute.does: Mutes the program audio; On while muted.

regions._center: What a source popup (role="source") and a window draw (docs/claude-design.md section 4), off the 1035's and 725's seeds' Laptop, Doc Cam, Help, Confirmation, Powering Down and Lighting Settings: the well's title Open Sans Light 24 in white, left, 15 px in (the system offers Open Sans, so 24 pt Open Sans); the empty state Light 16 white, centred; the well's headings white and its keys ghost (#FFFFFF32 off, #FFFFFF78 on); a window's title Light 24 white at its top left, its message Light 20 white centred, Close the word in a ghost cell (Open Sans 12, lifted to the 14 pt floor), Power Down #A829258C / #E23636 - `alert` - and Cancel ghost. Those sizes are the 1035's: a source popup and a window set what they say at each panel's own template's size, its frame's `pt` (the 725's titles 20 pt, its question 18).
regions._hub: What a hub's region page, source popups and windows draw (the 525's and 535's Main Page, Select Source, Laptop, Settings, Display Settings, Volume Level and Help). Measured off the 525 seed: titles Open Sans 30 (the frame's pt), black over the photo and white (`text`) on the Settings popup's opaque #303030 (`page`); a tile's name 14 pt under it; the Volume heading white (TextColor #FFFFFFFF) on the bar's black at 180; the menu bar's keys and every key on Settings, Display Settings and a settings window the raised white at alpha 50 (`ghost`: the Settings tiles, Close More Option and Close Help, the Display Settings keys and Lighting Settings' Close all (254,254,254,50)), and Select a Source's tiles and a source's Close over the photo black at 180 (`solid`); Mute its word (Open Sans 13 'Mute'); Help's title centred (TextAlignment 3) and its Close the back glyph; the options' glyphs the kit's `lighting` and `speaker` where Lighting/Blinds and Audio draw a bulb and a speaker. Chosen by eye from the renders: Up and Down the kit's `up` and `down` chevrons for the template's Extron-Lift ones, Settings, Power and Help the kit's glyphs for its Extron-Lift ones. Known differences: the template sets its menu glyphs in Extron-Lift at 20 to 24 pt and the kit's art fills its key, drawn Fill on the panel too, so ours are about twice the template's; Mute, set at 13 pt under the 525's 18 pt type floor, grows from 66 to 81 px; the Volume Level strip's speaker glyphs are Extron-Lift characters and are not drawn.

page._source: The 320's pages (seeds/Mach 320.gdl): its strip's white words on black at 70%, its headings and empty state black on the photo, its shade keys (`solid`), More the kit's ••• (more-options) and Back its back glyph on the shade, Back with no border where it ends the strip. The question and the waits say theirs white (`message`).

writing._source: The template's own words, off the 1035's and 725's seeds (their Laptop and PC popups, Confirmation, Starting Up, Powering Down and Help) and the grammar digest of every Mach page: the empty state of a source with no controls ({name} the popup's title), the power-down question, the waits, Help's message and the buttons' words. The 320 breaks the empty state over three lines; the bar series draw it in two. Help's title is its Help label's (`help_title`). A source page on the 320 says it over the three lines its template breaks it into (`page_empty`).

There are no controls for this device.

wait.up: Please wait while the system starts up.
wait.down: Please wait while the system is powering down.

For assistance, please call the help desk at:

X.XXX.XXX.XXXX

voice._source: Off seeds/Mach 1035.gdl's working pages, popups and windows - Main SD, Main VC, Main Recording, the Laptop, Doc Cam and TV popups, Lighting Settings, Camera Select, Confirmation, Starting Up, Powering Down and Help - and the grammar digest of every Mach page: its captions, rail headings, titles and messages. The rail's launchers are captioned Screen, Lighting and Audio (IDs 8115, 8116, 8020) and open the Screen, Lighting and Audio Settings windows; the confirmations answer Power Down, Record and Accept, never Yes or OK; the only capitals are the grey metadata labels of Recording Controls (TITLE:, USB STATUS:) and the 320's column labels.
rules: A caption is a short Title Case word or two that names the thing or the action: On, Off, Mute, Room Mode, Make Call, End Call, Power Down.
A rail launcher names what it opens - Screen, Lighting, Audio, Display - and the window it opens says the rest in its title: Lighting Settings.
A rail heading is one Title Case noun over its group: Display, Settings, Volume, VTC, Screen, Recording.
A popup's title is its device's name (Document Camera, Blu-ray, Laptop); a window's is what it holds (Lighting Settings, Camera Select, Help).

A message is a sentence in sentence case, with a period: the empty state, the waits. A question asks yes or no, and its button names the action - Power Down, Record, Accept - with Cancel or Decline beside it.
Words the programmer replaces stay placeholders: Room Title, X.XXX.XXX.XXXX.

Capitals are for a label over a set of keys on the small panels - ZOOM, FOCUS, INPUTS and IRIS over the 320's camera keys, DISPLAYS and SCREENS on the 525's Display Settings - and for Recording Controls' field labels (TITLE:, USB STATUS:, RECORDING LENGTH:). The 1035's own camera headings are Title Case: Inputs, Zoom, Focus, Iris.

kit.note: Extron's Mach resource kit: white icons on transparent, one image each; a state that swaps its icon names its own. Its slider art lives only in the seed and is extracted (vendor/README.md).
kit.icon_right_note: How far across a kit image its icon reaches, where the icon is at the image's left and an indented caption is centred past it: the 1376x440 icons' alpha (> 40) ends at x 223 to 319 of 1376 - the pc glyph the furthest - in the install's kit and vendor/. The region Header gives a tab's caption the leading spaces that put it a space clear of that reach.

_source: Series, sizes, DPI and tier: GUI Designer's own TemplateInfoTable.config, through gdl/templates.py; each series' models are the MODELS_FULL models gdl.templates.template_for gives it, by model.

main and rail: off the series template's own Main* pages (tests/measure_series.py control_regions). Mach lays its header and footer bars and its settings and volume columns over a photograph as controls, the footer's end buttons as wide as the columns' bands: main lies between the bars and between the end buttons, and the rail is the right band between the bars. The standard popup's window covers four-fifths of main and is not it.

The 520 and 535 hubs keep a menu bar down the right: main is the canvas left of it, the rail the bar. The 300 has a footer bar and no columns, so its rail is the footer, running across. The 320 keeps nothing on screen from page to page - its volume is a popup no page opens - so it has no rail.
popup: the template's standard popup region, where it fills a quarter of the canvas or more.

backgrounds: each theme's photograph from the kit, by its art's own name (tests/measure_series.py theme_backgrounds): every series but the 300 stretches the 3:2 5472x3648 ones; the 300 fills its own 320x480 ones. The template's default is its kit file pixel for pixel and keeps the template's name for it (mach-bg-02.png; the 300's mach_bg_02.png), which its seed carries with those pixels; the others take the kit file's, which the applier appends.

seeds, kinds: each seed in seeds/ by part number and canvas, and what control kinds it can clone - the 720's, 725's, 1035's, 1525's and 1535's a slider and no level; the 300M's, 320's, 525's and 535's a level and no slider; the 320's no popup.
